messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — customer BetaCo is pushing the pilot earlier than expected. they want SSO (SAML) working for invite-only pilot. can we avoid a timeline slip?
Sam Nguyen: do we have a minimal-compliance def? full SAML + admin UI is heavy.
Jordan Kim: happy path: stub SAML auth + service-account mapping behind FF, full admin flows in v1.
Maya Patel: customer says 'no delay preferred' but open to staged UX if we own comms. their target: ~3w from now.
Lee Ortega: rough ballpark — SSO stub + key mgmt + one end-to-end test = ~10 dev days + 3 qa days. admin UI is another 2–3 dev weeks.
Anika Bose: BetaCo will accept invite-only pilot with limited admin if we provide clear runbook and rollback plan. they care about login security more than reporting.
Sam Nguyen: so trade: cut analytics + quota admin from MVP, implement FF gated SAML stub. that should shave ~2w.
Maya Patel: can we formalize a candidate cutlist? I'm trying to be explicit for stakeholders.
Jordan Kim: candidate cuts for MVP: 1) analytics export UI, 2) per-tenant quota admin, 3) bulk tenant migration CLI. Keep: SAML stub, login mapping, basic tenant settings.
Lee Ortega: infra note — SAML stub still needs KMS integration for signing certs. that's non-negotiable. ops estimate: 3 infra days.
Sam Nguyen: I'll own the SAML stub. Plan: implement IdP metadata parser + auth handshake, accept attribute map only. No admin screens initially.
Maya Patel: sounds good. action: Sam implement, Lee infra + KMS, Jordan QA, Anika customer comms. timeline target: keep pilot date (1797776932 => ~1h in this thread as stand-in), but realistically target May 12.
Anika Bose: I'll draft the staged-UX email: "invite-only pilot with secure SSO, admin consoles follow in v1". will run by Maya before send.
Jordan Kim: QA checklist snippet: 
```
- idp metadata load
- signed assertion verification
- attribute mapping -> user mapping
- rollback: disable SAML FF
- monitor: auth failures / 5xx spikes
```
Maya Patel: include telemetry keys for auth failures + latency. Sam, add a telemetry event 'saml.login.attempt' and 'saml.login.failure'.
Sam Nguyen: ack — adding events and a short docs note. PR will include rollout notes and FF kill-switch.
Lee Ortega: heads up — need to update the infra runbook with cert rotation steps and the FF config path: `/flags/saml_pilot` in config-service.
Maya Patel: decision summary for the thread: 1) freeze analytics and quota admin from MVP; 2) implement SAML stub behind FF; 3) keep pilot target date and run invite-only pilot; 4) full SSO admin flows in v1. I'll update the roadmap board and product board.
Sam Nguyen: ping when roadmap updated so I can link PR -> ticket.
Anika Bose: I'll notify BetaCo after Maya signs off.
deploy-bot: staging deployment scheduled: 1797776000 — bump: run e2e auth tests after deployment.
Jordan Kim: quick UX ask — show clear modal on first login that SSO is in "pilot mode" and admin flows are coming. keeps expectations set.
Maya Patel: yep. small banner + link to runbook.
Sam Nguyen: will prototype banner copy in PR description.
Maya Patel: thanks team. tiny followup: can someone add these changes to the milestone tile? I'll link in the exec sync.
Lee Ortega: adding milestone update now. :white_check_mark:
Maya Patel: cool — closing this huddle. will post the cutlist + owners in the product board. :thumbsup:
